summary_en: Kaga Electronics (8154) public tender offer for Shinko Shoji (8141) ordinary shares at ¥1,580/share. Offer period May 18 – Aug 3, 2026. Offeror reiterates price is final ceiling; no increase planned. Target board maintains recommendation. Offer period ending Aug 3, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Public Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. by Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime 8154) commenced a public tender offer for all ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime 8141) on May 18, 2026, at ¥1,580 per share. This notice, issued July 29, 2026, reiterates the offeror's position that the ¥1,580 price represents the maximum and final price it is willing to offer, taking into account the interests of Shinko Shoji's general shareholders. Despite temporary trading of Shinko Shoji shares above ¥1,580 in the market, the offeror confirms no intention to increase the offer price and no plan to extend the offer period beyond the scheduled close on August 3, 2026, except as required by law. Shinko Shoji's board continues to recommend acceptance of the offer to shareholders.
